purpose: Create a separate, additive diagnostics interface that reads the authenticated Network Doctor APIs and displays existing evidence-based recommendations without modifying the core project.
allowed_changes: Use the existing authenticated read APIs
Launch the existing CLI through subprocess without shell execution
Display evidence-based remediation recommendations from diagnosis/remediation.py
Add tests that validate the addon behavior
forbidden_changes: Do not edit existing core project source files for business logic
Do not bypass API auth or agent token checks
Do not disable TLS verification or loosen destination protections
Do not create a parallel database or mutate persistence state
Do not expose tokens, credentials, or secrets in logs or UI
Do not claim implementation success without verification
recommended_behavior: Show overview, run-diagnostic, issues-and-solutions, history, and connection views.
Display existing evidence-based remediation guidance with read-only steps, risk warnings, and verification instructions.
Handle missing API connectivity as a read-only disconnected mode without crashing the UI.
Use environment variables for API_BASE_URL and API_TOKEN and validate the base URL for secure loopback-only local use.
validation: Run the full existing test suite with python -m pytest -q
Ensure the new addon tests pass and no core tests regress
